summary: Provider Status Badges A (full-stack, diagnostic-only). One server-owned, TTL-cached status endpoint + a compact AppNav badge row answering 'are Google and Naver connected right now?' — no direct browser calls to providers, no secrets/raw payloads exposed, no DB/migration/cron/LLM. Shared providerStatus.ts: ProviderStatusRowSchema .strict {id:enum(google,naver), label, state:enum(connected,disabled,degraded), code:enum(ok,disabled,denied,rate_limited,unavailable,invalid_response,config_error), checkedAt:ISO, ttlSeconds:int positive, message:≤120}; data {providers}; response {ok:true,data} .strict (rejects apiKey/clientSecret/headers/errorMessage/raw/url). Backend services/provider-status.ts createProviderStatusService({mapGateway,placeSearchGateway,ttlSeconds=300,now}): per-provider TTL cache (Map id→{row,expiresAt}; within TTL the cached row is returned with ZERO upstream call; now injectable; lazy refresh on request, no cron). Google row from the existing mapGateway.smoke() (data.status disabled→disabled, ok/zero_results→ok; error config_error/denied/rate_limited/unavailable→same neutral code, invalid_request/invalid_response→invalid_response); Naver row from the existing placeSearchGateway.search('강남역') fixed internal probe (ok→ok, error disabled→disabled, denied/rate_limited/unavailable/invalid_response→same, validation_error→invalid_response); any unknown→unavailable (default-deny); a thrown gateway → safe degraded unavailable (never a 500). state derives from code; message is STATIC Korean copy keyed by code — the gateway's own error.message, request URL, and credentials are DROPPED. routes/provider-status.ts GET /api/providers/status (thin, no body/query) → always {ok:true, data:{providers:[google,naver]}} (a degraded provider is a row state, not a failed response); registered in app.ts if(mapGateway && placeSearchGateway) OUTSIDE if(db) (404 without gateways). Frontend ProviderStatusBadges.tsx (in AppNav, every route): apiJson GET + safeParse(ProviderStatusResponseSchema); useEffect mount fetch + setInterval(300000) + clearInterval cleanup on unmount; single in-flight ref guard ignores overlapping fetches; on a transient fetch/parse failure PRESERVES the last known rows + marks them stale ('확인 중'), returns null (quiet) until the first success so a status outage NEVER breaks navigation. Passive text badges ('Google 연결됨'/'Naver 비활성'/'… 연결 안 됨' by state) with a semantic status dot + accessible aria-label; no tap action, no app-behavior change. styles .provider-status* (semantic tokens, passive chips). Roadmap doc updated (cycle 82 implemented); codebase-map updated. Tests: shared +4, server +6 (ok/disabled mapping; each degraded code + asserts response has no provider key/url text; thrown→unavailable; TTL reuse 0 calls within 300s then re-check; route 2-row schema-valid no-leak; 404 without gateways), frontend +5 (connected/disabled labels; degraded '연결 안 됨'; initial-fail quiet + AppNav links usable; later-poll-fail preserves+stale via fake timers; clearInterval on unmount).
